verdict.rationale: Poly documents natural-language full-text search (down to timestamp/page/paragraph), a CLI 'poly search' command, visual similarity search, and Finder-tag syncing, but nowhere combines these into documented filter syntax on tags/properties/paths, nor claims search works offline (files instead 'download on demand' and sync back, implying online-first indexing). missing for 10: explicit support for combined tag/property/path filters in search queries, explicit documentation of offline full-text search capability.
